title: Shrek 2 Remastered official at ID@Xbox: 10 Nov on Xbox Series X|S, pre-orders open
why: Confirms the 16 Oct leak we ran on 18 Oct; date, platform and the Game Pass pre-order discount are new.

claims.text: out 10 Nov 2026 on Xbox Series X|S
pre-orders open; up to 20% off with Game Pass, 10% for others, until 9 Nov
Photo Mode and Cheat Mode, improved graphics
